svg.text: Reconcile the approved plan with physical reality and find the fastest safe recovery path while preserving unaffected work and authority boundaries.
Numbering, naming and event linkage corrected.
Items marked FIXED changed in this edition.
Append changed fact preserving superseded value/provenance.
R4 immediately holds smallest safe affected scope and calls L3.
Search hierarchy: current executor → small resource adjustment →
redistribute team/resources → add support → continue unaffected tasks
→ replace affected role → prerequisite branch → targeted TaskBlock
rearchitecture → full JobOrder replan → cancel affected scope last
R2 invokes L4/L5 recovery without changing RequirementContract.
R3 invokes L2 targeted reanalysis only for affected nodes.
R5 remains CandidateFollowUp unless necessary prerequisite and
Request approval only when scope/price/time/policy requires it.
No resource solution → expand L4/L5 search.
Cannot isolate impact → full replan last resort.
No safe/viable recovery or customer declines → L7 cancellation path.
Executor submits facts, not blame or self-priced changes.
R0–R5 are semantic classes, NOT severity.
Physical reality is authoritative but cannot bypass controls.
Continue unaffected TaskBlocks when dependencies/safety allow.
Full replan and cancellation are last resort.
R0 · Confirmed as planned → Execute approved plan
R1 · Minor operational variance → Adjust locally; no architecture
R2 · Fulfillment/resource variance → Requirement valid; change
R4 · Safety/regulatory change → Immediate affected-scope hold + L3
R5 · Independent new work → CandidateFollowUp/branch with consent
L09A-G1 · R2 missing tool resolved without RC change
L09A-G2 · R3 incompatible connection produces RC vN+1 only for
L09A-G3 · R5 unrelated faucet repair remains CandidateFollowUp
Board regenerated from the corrected canonical set. Text is real SVG text — readable by script, not only by eye.
Every consumed event on this board has exactly one producer, or is declared external. Open rulings are listed in the canonical file, not decided here.
